posts.name: Nathan Lambert
posts.text:
The open model world faces two main challenges in a post-Jensen world:
1. Political exposure. Open models’ allies are retreating in DC.
2. Investment. Open model builders need to find profitable products far sooner w/o his backstop.

Will feel it sooner than people expect.

posts.author: natolambert
posts.name: Nathan Lambert
posts.text: It's easy to not realize how much of a messy, decentralized beast the open models / open source AI community is. Jensen held it together.
